title: Priya · Q2 2026 filing session
lines: # Priya's Homemade Pickles, proprietorship in Maharashtra
# prior-FY turnover Rs 4,200,000.00, goods, sells to Karnataka (inter-state)
sub: Priya sells pickles from Pune. Prior-year turnover Rs 42 lakh - a small business that must file GST.

title: Priya · Q2 2026 filing session
lines: "Inter-state supply of goods makes registration compulsory at any turnover",
"Goods turnover Rs 4,200,000 exceeds the normal-category threshold of Rs 4,000,000",
"State 27 is a normal-category state: goods threshold Rs 4,000,000, services threshold Rs 2,000,000"
"Composition suppliers cannot make inter-state supply of goods"
# Registration: required; composition scheme: not available (inter-state goods supply blocks it); filer type: qrdp
sub: Verdict: registration is required (inter-state goods supply), and the composition scheme is not available to her. Filer type: quarterly.

title: Priya · Q2 2026 filing session
lines: == Step 2 · when must this quarter be filed? ==
# Q2 (Jul-Sep 2026): GSTR-1 by 13 Oct 2026, GSTR-3B by 22 Oct 2026 (Maharashtra QRDP category X), tax challan by 25 Oct 2026
sub: Quarterly (QRDP) dates for Maharashtra: GSTR-1 by 13 Oct, GSTR-3B by 22 Oct, payment by 25 Oct.

title: Priya · Q2 2026 filing session
lines: "note": "Reverse charge: recipient pays GST directly; no tax on the invoice",
# Rs 400 self-assessed under reverse charge - paid in cash, then claimed as ITC in the same return (net nil, but it must be reported)
sub: Reverse-charge freight: Rs 400 self-assessed, paid in cash, claimed back as ITC in the same return.

title: Priya · Q2 2026 filing session
lines: "recommendation": "Resolve mismatches before filing GSTR-3B: claim only the matched plus in-2B amounts; follow up with suppliers on missing invoices"

# Claim only Rs 1,620 now. Rs 1,080 catering credit is blocked under section 17(5)(b); Rs 2,160 invoice is missing from 2B - chase the supplier; Rs 400 difference on the jar vendor needs reconciliation
sub: ITC reconciliation against GSTR-2B: claim Rs 1,620 now; the module flags a blocked credit, a mismatch and an invoice missing from 2B.

title: Priya · Q2 2026 filing session
lines: # Rs 6,99,600 taxable, Rs 25,980 tax net of the credit note. B2C-large (5A) catches the Rs 3.2 lakh Bengaluru order that would otherwise hide in B2C-small
sub: GSTR-1 totals: Rs 6,99,600 taxable and Rs 25,980 tax, net of the credit note. The Rs 3.2 lakh B2C order lands in the right table (5A).

title: Priya · Q2 2026 filing session
lines: == Step 6 · e-invoice check on the Meridian order ==
# E-invoicing is not mandatory below Rs 5 crore turnover, but the buyer's AP team asked for an e-invoice-ready bill: valid
sub: E-invoicing is not mandatory below Rs 5 crore turnover, but the buyer asked for an e-invoice-ready bill: it validates.

title: Priya · Q2 2026 filing session
lines: "Turnover differs by 5.5% (Rs 230,000); the ITC reconciliation statement expects ITR >= GSTR turnover and flags variances beyond ~5%",
"ITR turnover higher than GST turnover: GST-registered supplies may be missing from returns, or exempt/nil-rate receipts explain it"
# ITR shows Rs 2,30,000 (5.5%) more than GST turnover - above the 5% band the department's comparators use; explain or amend before the notice
sub: ITR crossover: ITR shows 5.5% more than GST turnover - above the 5% band the department's comparators use. Explain it before a notice does.

title: Priya · Q2 2026 filing session
lines: == Step 8 · advance-tax estimate for next year ==
# Projected Rs 16.5 lakh income: Rs 1,20,900 tax, four instalments - 15 June / 15 Sep / 15 Dec / 15 Mar
sub: Advance tax for next year: Rs 1,20,900 in four instalments, new regime vs old compared automatically.

title: Priya · Q2 2026 filing session
